modules.module_title: Perform Setup of CNC Machines with reading blueprints, tool selection & installation, machine calibration.

pcs.pc_description: identify and interpret technical drawings and blueprints to determine the specifications and requirements. And develop a clear plan for the setup process based on the information obtained from the blueprints.
Select the correct cutting tools and attachments for the specific machining task and install them accurately. And perform tool configuration to ensure that tools are correctly positioned.
Perform calibration of CNC machine’s settings, including axis movements, spindle speeds, and feed rates, to match the job requirements and perform test runs.

modules.module_title: Implement operation of CNC Machines with machine programming and execution.

pcs.pc_description: Develop and edit CNC programs using CAD/CAM software to generate the required G-code and M-code. Input the CNC programs into the machine's control system and verify their correctness.
Execute the Machining Process, load raw materials or workpieces into the machine, ensuring they are securely fastened. Continuously monitor machine operations to ensure they run smoothly

• Conduct Regular Inspections with use of precision measuring tools (e.g., calipers, micrometers, gauges) • Keep detailed records of the machining process, including any adjustments made and inspection results, and report any significant issues or deviations to the appropriate personnel for further analysis.

modules.module_title: Conduct quality control and regular maintenance, troubleshoot any operational issues.

pcs.pc_description: Conduct Thorough Quality Control by having detailed inspections of machined parts using precision measuring tools to ensure they meet all specified tolerances and quality standards.
Perform scheduled maintenance tasks such as cleaning, lubrication, and parts replacement to keep CNC machines in optimal working condition.
Implement & quickly diagnose operational issues with CNC machines, such as mechanical failures, programming errors, or tool wear, using troubleshooting techniques and diagnostic tools.
Maintain comprehensive records of all maintenance activities, including dates, tasks performed, parts replaced, and any issues encountered.

modules.module_title: Identify cutting tools based on the material being machined, desired surface finish

pcs.pc_description: Analyze the properties of the material to be machined, such as hardness, toughness, and thermal conductivity, to select cutting tools that can handle the specific characteristics of the material without excessive wear.
Determine the desired surface finish and tolerances for the final product, choosing cutting tools with the appropriate geometry, edge sharpness, and coating to achieve the required surface quality.

Select the cutting tool materials (e.g., high- speed steel, carbide, ceramics) and coatings (e.g., TiN, TiAlN, diamond) that match the machining conditions and enhance tool life, performance, and the ability to achieve the desired finish.

modules.module_title: Conduct precisely installation of cutting tools in the machine spindle

pcs.pc_description: Ensure cleaning the tool holder and spindle to remove any debris or contaminants that could affect tool alignment and stability. And handle the cutting tools carefully to avoid damage to the cutting edges and maintain their precision.

Align the cutting tool accurately in the spindle or tool holder using alignment tools or precision instruments to ensure correct positioning. Secure the tool tightly using the appropriate clamping mechanism (e.g., collet, chuck, or hydraulic tool holder) to prevent movement or slippage during machining operation

Verify tool setup by measuring runout and ensuring minimal deviation from the spindle axis to maintain accuracy. Perform a trial run or test cut to verify proper installation and make any necessary adjustments to achieve optimal performance and precision.

modules.module_title: Perform initial testing and optimization of tool paths and cutting parameters to validate tool performance

pcs.pc_description: Conduct initial test runs with the selected cutting tools and tool paths on a sample material to evaluate the basic performance, ensuring that the tool engages the material correctly without excessive vibration or deflection.
Analyze key cutting parameters such as spindle speed, feed rate, and depth of cut during the initial tests, observing the tool's behavior and the quality of the machined surface.
Monitor the condition of the cutting tools for signs of wear, chipping, or other issues, and inspect the workpiece for surface finish, dimensional accuracy, and potential defects.
Optimize & adjust the cutting parameters and tool paths based on the test results to enhance performance, achieving the desired balance between machining efficiency, tool life, and workpiece quality.

modules.module_title: Identify & selection of Appropriate Measurement Tools.

pcs.pc_description: Assess the geometry, material, and tolerances of the part to be measured, considering factors such as size, shape, surface finish, and dimensional complexity.

Identify suitable measurement tools and techniques based on the specific features and dimensions of the part, selecting tools such as calipers, micrometers, height gauges, CMMs, or optical measurement systems.
Evaluate the required level of accuracy and precision for the measurement task, choosing measurement tools with appropriate resolution and sensitivity to ensure accurate and reliable results.

modules.module_title: Implementation of standardized inspection procedures, including setup of measurement equipment

pcs.pc_description: Perform standardized inspection protocols established for the specific type of parts or components being inspected, including procedures for setup, measurement, and documentation.
Ensure the set-up measurement equipment according to prescribed procedures, including calibration checks and adjustments to ensure accuracy and repeatability.
Implement compliance with safety protocols and quality standards during equipment setup and inspection activities, prioritizing the safety of personnel and the accuracy of inspection results.

modules.module_title: Analysis of inspection data to verify part dimensions and tolerances against engineering drawings

pcs.pc_description: Interpret engineering drawings and specifications accurately to understand the required part dimensions, tolerances, and geometric features specified by the design.
Collect measurement data from inspection activities using appropriate tools and techniques, ensuring accuracy and consistency in data collection.

Perform comparison of the measured dimensions and tolerances obtained from inspection data with the corresponding values specified in the engineering drawings, identifying any deviations or discrepancies.
Analyze the inspection data comprehensively to determine whether the measured dimensions and tolerances fall within acceptable limits defined by the engineering drawings.
